[color=#00ffff]这是一个小农舍，有CP版本和PIF版本，可以一起安装使用。
3级农舍有一个大阳台，需要先装修阁楼才会出现。

The third level farmhouse has a large balcony that requires decoration of the far upper room before it can appear.[/color][/size]

[color=#ff0000]CP version bug:
On the first day of each season, the wine cellar entrance and spouse room furniture may disappear, but reopening the game can restore them.[/color][/size]
